title: Brain-B movement reference: anticipation + locomotion contracts (AUTH #043)
summary: The deterministic Python reference the Unity runtime (Brain A) must match for the AUTH #043 fluidity/realism pack: an anticipation planner over the traversal graph and the stride/landing/scale reference math. Derived/reference only (like reach.py) — no frozen v1.0.0 schema field and no movement.json edit here.

acceptance_tests.test: anticipation.plan_anticipation emits deterministic per-edge hints for the contact verbs of a route (skipping pure locomotion), with contact point, hand pre-reach, gaze look-ahead, per-category lead-time and plant foot; every frozen-tier verb has an anticipation category.

locomotion_ref provides stride_scale (clamped, monotonic), landing_response (Bible §5 tiers + soft-surface bonus) and the miniature cadence dial (sqrt(scale) ceiling + realism fraction), all unit-tested.
The C# runtime contracts for #1/#2/#3/#5/#6 are documented for gj-gameplay to implement against.

auth_required.what: new Brain-B reference modules (no protected path); part of AUTH #043
